title: Let devotion quiet the wandering appetite
summary: Devotion brings bliss and lets the wandering mind rest at the Lord's feet. When restlessness wants novelty, stay where devotion is already becoming sweet.
takeaway: Meet spiritual restlessness by staying at the feet already giving peace.
lifeApplication: When the appetite starts searching for one more spiritual high, stay with the practice already warming the heart. Let the feet of the Lord become enough for this moment.

source.shortMeaning: Devotion brings bliss and lets the wandering mind rest at the Lord's feet.
source.lifeApplication: When restlessness asks for novelty, answer it with deeper devotion instead.

evidence.coreClaim: Devotion brings bliss and lets the wandering mind rest at the Lord's feet.
evidence.turn: Rest at the Lord's feet before novelty gets to rename itself as seeking.
